CHN.note: China is the world's #1 tomato-paste exporter; Xinjiang is >80% of national processing (WPTC 2024: 10.45 Mt raw intake, the global record). Product-weight paste/preserved output ~1.9 Mt, ~1.2 Mt exported to MENA, Africa, Far East and Europe, 2024 (WPTC / UN Comtrade 2024).

ITA.note: Italy is the #1 EU processor (WPTC 2024: ~5.25 Mt raw intake); dominant supplier of finished preserved tomatoes/passata to the EU and UK. Product-weight balance ~2.0 Mt output; net exporter, also imports Chinese bulk paste for re-processing, 2024 (WPTC / Eurostat 2024).

USA.note: US processing is concentrated in California (WPTC 2024: ~10.25 Mt raw intake). Large domestic consumption (sauces, food-service); product-weight balance ~1.7 Mt, modest net exporter to USMCA and Asia, 2024 (USDA / WPTC 2024).

ESP.note: Spain (Extremadura/Andalusia) is a major EU processor and ingredient exporter; product-weight balance ~0.48 Mt, net exporter within the EU, 2024 (WPTC / Eurostat 2024).

PRT.note: Portugal (Tagus/Sado valleys) is a concentrated paste exporter relative to its small domestic market; product-weight balance ~0.34 Mt, strong net exporter, 2024 (WPTC / Eurostat 2024).

IRN.note: Iran is a top-five global processor with large domestic paste consumption; exports to neighbouring MENA/Central Asia markets, product-weight ~0.45 Mt, 2024 (WPTC 2024 / USDA).

TUR.note: Turkey is a major Mediterranean processor exporting paste and preserved vegetables to the EU and MENA; product-weight balance ~0.42 Mt, net exporter, 2024 (WPTC / UN Comtrade 2024).

DEU.note: Germany is a leading EU importer of finished and bulk processed tomatoes/preserved vegetables from Italy, Spain, Portugal and China; small domestic processing, large net importer, 2024 (Eurostat / UN Comtrade 2024).

GBR.note: The UK has minimal domestic processing and is one of the largest net importers of preserved tomatoes/vegetables, led by Italy, Portugal, Spain and Greece, 2024 (UN Comtrade / HMRC 2024).

FRA.note: France imports the bulk of its preserved-tomato consumption from Italy and Spain despite some domestic processing; net importer, 2024 (Eurostat / UN Comtrade 2024).

JPN.note: Japan has negligible domestic processing and imports preserved tomatoes/vegetables from Italy, the US, Portugal, Chile and China; large net importer, 2024 (UN Comtrade / USDA 2024).

SAU.note: Saudi Arabia imports bulk tomato paste (largely Chinese) for domestic repacking and re-export within the Gulf; import-dependent MENA market, 2024 (UN Comtrade 2024).

EGY.note: Egypt processes domestically but still imports bulk paste in deficit years; food-security-sensitive MENA market reliant on imported processed vegetables, 2024 (USDA / UN Comtrade 2024).

NGA.note: Nigeria is a major destination for bulk Chinese tomato paste repacked into sachets for the domestic market; large net importer with chronic processing gap, 2024 (UN Comtrade / USDA 2024).

CHL.note: Chile is the leading Southern-Hemisphere processor, exporting paste and preserved tomatoes to Japan, Argentina and the US; product-weight ~0.18 Mt, net exporter, 2024 (WPTC / UN Comtrade 2024).
